newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish groom dies driving bride home from wedding.
newsitem.headline: Turkish groom dies driving bride home from wedding.

text.p: A wedding in eastern Turkey ended in tragedy on Friday when a bus driven by the groom rolled into a ditch, killing him and four others and injuring his bride, Anatolian news agency said.
The bride was among 20 people hurt in the crash.

The bus bringing guests back from the wedding in the eastern city of Elazig to the couple's new home in Dogansehir went into the ditch after the driver, Orhan Eren, failed to negotiate a bend, the agency said.
